question: After APP-SYN-01 serial closeout and Director deferral of CLR F2/F1 until representative real app assembly, does current live Product/Engineering/Design authority provide the representative assembly trigger or independently authorize another Design gate?

findings.detail: Website main has no active serial Design branch. APP-SYN-01 remains frozen with Director CLR context deferred until representative real assembly; F2 is Design Sol's non-authoritative preference and F1 remains materially valid. No CLR winner exists.

Project main is in Q-E0C-01 repeated identical-condition experimental preactivation. Fresh rate-limit/tier/capacity gates pass, but exact Kymaean project/account association and the fixed UTC batch window remain pending; provider traffic is zero. Q-E0D-01 remains blocked. This creates no native app shell, real app assembly, Design authority, or Stage visual authority.

Phase C exit requires a Director-approved shared identity system sufficiently specific to guide native-app and website design. Phase D translates the selected identity into the native-product experience. The deferred CLR context therefore does not itself authorize Phase D or implementation-like assembly.

Project execution queue still lists Q-DESIGN-19 as ACTIVE CLR-01 materialization. Website lane authority has progressed far beyond that item; queue law states stronger lane authority wins. The stale row must not reopen CLR or override Website CURRENT_STATE. No Project mutation is made from the Design lane during active E0-C work.
APP-SYN-01 exposed a Stage-to-app-shell adjacency/shared surface-hierarchy gap, but the Director deferral explicitly did not activate that follow-on gate. No new evidence now changes that boundary.

decision: Remain parked. Do not open a new serial Design gate, select CLR F2/F1, claim Phase C exit, enter Phase D, or synthesize a surrogate real assembly. Re-enter only when representative real app assembly becomes authoritative or the Director explicitly authorizes a bounded Phase C assembly context that supplies that missing evidence.
